cohort: 120 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies >37 weeks’ gestation, cephalic presentation with an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score ≤ 6), no signs of labor
finding: Propess was as safe as Prostin E2 for induction of labor, but was associated with a shorter induction-to-birth interval, a higher rate of vaginal delivery in 24 h, and a lower number of vaginal examinations.
